body:
## Fix

F1. Validate card/text/image numeric-id-modulo placement before flattening catalog shards. A record in the wrong shard previously passed verification even though runtime lookup could miss it.
F2. Add local synthetic-snapshot regression: card 65 under shard 02 must be rejected because its expected shard is 01.

## Validation

V1. Regression incorrectly received verifier status ok before fix; passes after fix.
V2. Parent reran catalog, strings, transform/shard, verifier tests: 8 passed.
V3. Worker read-only verification of real local snapshot passed: 14,794 cards/texts/images.
V4. Parent reviewed shard invariant, failure accumulation, synthetic manifest/hash setup, and scoped diff. No blocking finding.
V5. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; Node-only verifier change. No acquisition, asset mutation, or publication. CI remains separate.
title: fix(assets): reject catalog records in wrong shards
